lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in a multi-row horizontal grid posterior to the fifth gill slit. Centroids are most defined in the mid-lateral zone, showing roughly equidistant spacing between local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming defined anchor nodes in a rectangular-grid orientation across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by high-intensity pixel highlights on the superior edge and deep shadow gradients on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent network of caustics (refracted surface light) creates a high-contrast overlapping pattern across the dorsal surface; presence of multiple small associated teleost fish near the pectoral-ventral transition.
